description: Change a published page's visibility, search-engine indexing or password WITHOUT republishing it — the URL, view count and content all stay the same. Use this instead of deleting and publishing again, which changes the link the user already shared. Send only the fields you want to change. Turning a paid capability off never needs an entitlement; turning one on is checked against the current plan. A password always forces the page private, so asking for both `public: true` and a password is refused rather than silently resolved. dochost branding is NOT settable here: it is resolved from the account's live plan at render time, so there is nothing per-page to flip — read `brandingHidden` from get_page for the rendered answer.

password.description: Set or replace the page password (paid plans).

public.description: Discoverable on Explore. Cannot be true while a password is set.

removePassword.description: Clear the password. Always allowed, on any plan.

searchable.description: Opt in to search-engine indexing. Turning it on requires a permanent page.

name: set_page_options

changed.description: False when the page already had exactly these settings.

title: Change a published page’s settings
